dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: You think so? Well, I don't do it for any kind of praise or approval.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: But since I am branch master and all that, I guess I have to show I'm making an effort or something.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: I jotted down some thoughts on adventuring back when I was looking for the sword. Here, take them. Maybe you'll find them useful.
